generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and condition as per KW-3
Quoted rates should be excluding GST for all items

Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)

Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in atleast two financial years an average turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant).i.e., Rs.117.97 Lakhs

The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of works usually 80% of the annual requirement of providing and laying 100mm & 200mm DI (K9) pipeline 856 rmt & 338.8 rmt respectively

"A" class GI pipe as casing over the MDPE pipe from the bore point and upto the entrance of the premises and removing the stone slab covering of the drain and dismantling the size stone masonry wherever necessary and making bore in the wall of the premises.
